seo.meta_title: Is True Food Kitchen Closing? 2026 Bankruptcy Explained
seo.meta_description: True Food Kitchen filed for Chapter 11 in October 2026 and closed 12 of its 46 restaurants. The other 34 are open while it looks for a buyer. Who owns it.

question: Is True Food Kitchen Closing?
quick_answer: Not entirely. True Food Kitchen filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy on October 4, 2026, and immediately closed 12 restaurants, about a quarter of its 46 locations. Its remaining 34 restaurants are still open and operating normally while the company looks for a new owner through a court-supervised sale. The health-focused chain was founded in Phoenix in 2008 by Dr. Andrew Weil and restaurateur Sam Fox.
key_facts: Seeking a new owner through a court sale
Founded in Phoenix in 2008 by Andrew Weil and Sam Fox

body.heading: What happened
body.text: True Food Kitchen and some of its affiliates filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in federal court in Texas on October 4, 2026. As part of the filing, it closed 12 restaurants right away, including both of its New Jersey locations and three in Southern California. The company entered bankruptcy with about $42 million in debt and said it would use the process to cut costs, shrink its footprint and improve its remaining restaurants.

body.heading: Is your True Food Kitchen still open?
body.text: True Food Kitchen has said it is not going out of business. Its remaining 34 restaurants continue to operate during the bankruptcy, and guests can dine at open locations as usual. Because 12 locations closed suddenly, check the True Food Kitchen website or app for your nearest open restaurant before you go.

body.heading: Who owns True Food Kitchen
body.text: True Food Kitchen was founded in Phoenix in 2008 by integrative-medicine doctor Andrew Weil and restaurateur Sam Fox. It later brought in outside investors, including Oprah Winfrey, who joined the board in 2018 and is still a minority investor, and HumanCo, a health-focused investment firm. As part of the bankruptcy, the company is seeking a new owner through a court-supervised sale, so ownership is likely to change.

body.heading: Why True Food Kitchen struggled
body.text: The chain expanded quickly, from about 20 locations in 2017 to 46, and its leaders changed several times in recent years. Before filing, it hired former Hopdoddy CEO Jeff Chandler in July 2026, laid off corporate staff and brought in advisers to review its real estate.

body.heading: What True Food Kitchen serves
body.text: True Food Kitchen is known for its health-focused, seasonal menu of grain bowls, salads, sourdough pizzas, burgers and fresh juices. Prices are higher than fast casual, with most bowls around $21 to $22. See our True Food Kitchen menu page for prices.

faqs.q: Is True Food Kitchen going out of business?
faqs.a: No. It filed for Chapter 11 and closed 12 restaurants, but 34 locations remain open while it seeks a buyer.

faqs.q: How many True Food Kitchen locations closed?
faqs.a: 12, about a quarter of its 46 restaurants, in October 2026.
It's owned by a group of investors, including HumanCo and minority investor Oprah Winfrey, and is being sold through a court-supervised process.
